d:
Bombai Ka Babu (1960) is a iconic classic black-and-white Hindi crime drama film directed by Raj Khosla. Starring Dev Anand and Suchitra Sen, the narrative follows a small-time thief forced into an identity theft plot, featuring timeless music composed by S.D. Burman.
'bambaee ka babu' (1960) raj khosla dvara nirdeshit ek prasiddh klasik blaik-end-vhait hindi kraim drama philm hai. dev aanand aur suchitra sen abhinit, iski kahani ek chor ke ird-gird ghumti hai jise pahchan badalne ke lie majbur kiya jata hai, jismen es. di. barman ka sadabhar sangit shamil hai.'
Movie : Bombai Ka Babu (1960)
